about.title: Behind the Needles & Gears
about.subtitle: A family-run shop in the heart of Kesarganj, Ajmer. For 30 years, we've helped tailors, boutiques, and home sewing enthusiasts find their perfect stitch.
about.storyP1: It all started in 1995 with nothing but a single metal toolbox, a flask of warm sweet tea, and a simple promise: to treat every customer's machine like our very own. Back then, Kesarganj was a bustling hub of traditional master dardi tailors. When their manual hand-crank machines jammed, we were there to solve it.
about.storyP2: As Ajmer grew, we did too. But we made a conscious choice: never to become a cold, distant corporate showroom. For us, a sewing machine is not just a piece of iron and steel; it is the source of food, children's school fees, and self-respect for a family. Whether it's a simple domestic model for stitching kitchen curtains or a heavy computerized system for bridal lehengas, we give it our full heart.
about.storyP3: Today, we are honored to be the first destination for tailors traveling from Beawar, Kishangarh, Nasirabad, and villages across Rajasthan. No fancy, complicated contracts — just honest handshakes, warm tea, and relationships that span generations.
about.ownerQuote: "A sewing machine only asks for two simple things: a drop of good oil and honest respect. If you give it both, it will run for a lifetime without skipping a single stitch."
about.ownerBio: Dinesh ji started repairing mechanical machines in his early teenage years, sitting beside old masters. Today, with over 30 years of grease on his hands, he is known across Ajmer for his diagnostic ear. Just by listening to the sound of a sewing machine, he can instantly tell you if the timing gear is worn or if the shuttle simply needs minor alignment. He personally oversees every single major repair job.
about.missionDesc: To ensure no tailor’s work is interrupted by a technical breakdown. We aim to provide affordable, lifetime machine servicing with 100% genuine spare parts so our local community can work with pride and safety.
about.visionDesc: To keep the rich tailoring heritage of Ajmer thriving by introducing cost-effective modern electric motors, energy-saving upgrades, and training local youngsters in machine maintenance.
about.trustReason1Desc: If a machine only needs a basic oil clean or thread tension adjustment, we will never tell you to replace the shuttle hook. We explain the exact issue in plain, simple Hindi or English.
about.trustReason2Desc: We only stock verified, genuine needles, bobbin cases, and motor belts from trusted brands like Usha, Singer, and Juki. No cheap copycats that destroy machine health.
about.trustReason3Desc: We know that tailors have tight festival and wedding deadlines. If your machine breaks during peak season, we work overtime to get you running the very same day.
about.trustReason4Desc: Our relation doesn't end with a bill receipt. You can always stop by for a cup of tea and a quick minor tuning whenever you feel the needle stitch is uneven.
about.workshopPhotosSub: A real, cozy look behind the scenes — where screwdrivers, engine oil, and mechanical passion bring old machines back to life.
about.timelineSub: A small walk down memory lane, tracking our path from a single toolbox to Ajmer's beloved sewing landmark.
about.t1995Desc: Dinesh ji starts with a single steel toolbox and a bicycle, visiting local tailors' shops to fix mechanical stitch tension issues on-site.
about.t2002Desc: We opened our physical showroom in Kesarganj, Ajmer. We became authorized dealers, making quality sewing machines accessible locally.
about.t2012Desc: Began offering direct-drive energy-saving servo motors and industrial lockstitch machines as local tailoring shops grew into full boutiques.
about.t2020Desc: Introduced smart computerized embroidery systems and started free on-site training to help women and local youth learn digital patterns.
about.tTodayDesc: With the same warm kettle of tea, honest advice, and friendly pricing, we continue to keep the needles of Ajmer running smoothly.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common queries about sales, home repair services, and warranties in Ajmer.

items.q: Do you provide sewing machine repair services at home in Ajmer?
items.a: Yes! We provide doorstep repair and installation services across Kesarganj and general Ajmer localities. For major faults, we also offer pick-up and drop-back services.

items.q: Which brands of sewing machines do you sell?
items.a: We are authorized dealers and service partners for USHA, SINGER, JACK, BROTHER, and MERRITT. You can get brand-new models with full official warranty cards from us.

items.q: Are the spare parts used during repairs original?
items.a: Absolutely. We only use 100% genuine and brand-authorized spare parts (motors, needle bars, bobbin cases, gears) to ensure a long life and smooth operation of your machine.

items.q: Is there any warranty on your repair work?
items.a: Yes, we stand by our craft. We provide a 30-day service warranty on our repairs. If the exact same issue arises again, we will fix it free of charge.

items.q: Do you offer demo classes for computerized embroidery machines?
items.a: Yes, we provide a complete, hands-on demonstration and tutorial on how to use computerized zigzag/embroidery machines upon purchase or installation, completely free of cost.
